Ethereum’s Swift Deal Comes With a Catch

Swift built that ledger on Hyperledger Besu, though, a permissioned private version of Ethereum that doesn’t require burning ETH or paying gas fees on the public mainnet.
That means no direct economic benefit flows to ETH holders yet. Besu nodes can still connect to the public mainnet, which Altcoin Daily calls an early step toward deeper integration down the line.

Where the Broader Market Could Head Next
Crypto’s total market cap grew from under $1 trillion in 2017 to $2.8 trillion by late 2021, then topped out near $4.2 trillion last cycle.
Altcoin Daily’s bear case for the next cycle sits around $6 trillion, with a base case of $10 to $12 trillion.
Under that scenario, Bitcoin could take 50% to 70% of total market share, implying a price range of $180,000 to $250,000, with altcoins absorbing the rest.
